human_review_text: The paper proposes a method for assessing language models by leveraging word guessing games, specifically the SpyFall game. The authors tested the ability of LLMs to generate world descriptions and intentional disguise descriptions, and introduced the framework of the SpyGame, which includes agent actions and voting. The authors also conducted model bias evaluations to ensure fairness and accuracy in the evaluation process.
